title: Asian Group – CNCBUILD 1530 CNC Router Fault Diagnosis & Repair

date.notes: Ongoing project as of 2026-09-22. Exact start date has not been confirmed.

summary: Ongoing fault-diagnosis and repair project for a CNCBUILD 1530 CNC Router using a SYNTEC 6MD control system at Asian Group of Companies, Kohilawatta. The machine has an unresolved condition where the X and Y axes can become stuck or stop during operation. Several previous repair attempts had not resolved the issue. Detailed diagnosis has not yet started, so the root cause, repair method and final outcome remain unconfirmed.
problem: The CNC router intermittently becomes stuck or stops on the X and Y axes. The issue remained unresolved after previous repair attempts by others.
scope: Electrical, control and motion-system troubleshooting as required
